title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 33
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 33: the evil reign of Manasseh, his captivity and repentance, and the short reign of Amon.

questions.text: How old was Manasseh when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.

answers.text: Eight years old
Sixteen years old
Twenty-five years old
Twelve years old

questions.text: What did Manasseh build again that Hezekiah his father had broken down?
questions.explanation: He built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down.

answers.text: The palace of Solomon
The high places
The gates of Samaria
The tower of Babel

questions.text: Where did Manasseh make his children pass through the fire?
questions.explanation: He made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom.

answers.text: In the valley of the son of Hinnom
At the brook Kidron
In the valley of Megiddo
On the plain of Jericho

questions.text: After Manasseh seduced Judah and Jerusalem, whom did they do more evil than?
questions.explanation: They did more evil than the nations whom Yahweh destroyed before the children of Israel.

answers.text: Their fathers in the wilderness of Sinai
The people of Sodom and Gomorrah
The nations whom Yahweh destroyed before Israel
The kings and princes of Egypt

questions.text: Who took Manasseh in chains and carried him to Babylon?
questions.explanation: Yahweh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Assyria, who took Manasseh in chains and carried him to Babylon.

answers.text: The army captains of the king of Assyria
The soldiers of the king of Egypt
The warriors of the Philistines
The men of Moab and Ammon

questions.text: What did Manasseh do when he was in distress?
questions.explanation: When he was in distress, he begged Yahweh his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.

answers.text: He cursed the God of his fathers
He tried to escape from prison
He sent gifts to the king of Egypt
He begged Yahweh and humbled himself greatly

questions.text: What did Manasseh build after he was brought back to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He built an outer wall to David's city, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate.

answers.text: A new temple for the Baals
An outer wall to David's city
A palace in Samaria
A fleet of ships at the sea

questions.text: What did Manasseh take away from Yahweh's house after his return?
questions.explanation: He took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of Yahweh's house, and cast them out of the city.

answers.text: The ark of the covenant
The golden lampstands
The foreign gods and the idol
The bronze altar of Solomon

questions.text: How did Amon the son of Manasseh die?
questions.explanation: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.

answers.text: His servants conspired and killed him in his own house
He fell in battle against the king of Assyria
He died of a long illness in his bed
He was taken captive and died in Babylon

questions.text: Who did the people of the land make king in Amon's place?
questions.explanation: The people of the land killed those who had conspired against king Amon, and made Josiah his son king in his place.

answers.text: Hezekiah his son
Jehoahaz his brother
Josiah his son
Zedekiah his son
